scenes.a: If a hidden trouble is weighing on your heart right now, hear God's unfailing word.
Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble;
thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance.
Lord, be the secure refuge surrounding this heart against every rising fear and unseen danger.
Where anxiety seeks to overtake their thoughts, enclose them completely in Your protective peace.
Shield them on every side and surround their soul with songs of deliverance and strength.
Keep their steps safe from harm today, grounding their spirit in Your unshakeable presence. Amen.
Subscribe to The Covenant Shield to walk under God's daily covering.
